units.source_text: 家将是蜥蜴似的忍了足音，爬一般的才到了这峻急的梯子的最上的第一级。

en.t: The servant, like a lizard, muffled his footsteps and, as though crawling, finally reached the uppermost rung of the steep ladder.

units.source_text: 竭力的帖伏了身子，竭力的伸长了颈子，望到楼里面去。

en.t: Pressing his body down as hard as he could and stretching his neck as far as he could, he peered inside the upper story.
